# `gcp.targetsslproxy`

Represents a TargetSslProxy resource, which is used by one or more global forwarding rule to route incoming SSL requests to a backend service.

[compute](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| --- | --- |
| Service | compute |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `compute.googleapis.com/TargetSslProxy` |
| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
| Mutation timeout | 600s |
